st-ch-dist-chandigarh.name: Chandigarh
st-ch-dist-chandigarh.description: District of Chandigarh (Union Territory), India, headquartered at Chandigarh. Population approximately 1,055,450 (2011 census), area approximately 114 km2.

st-ch-urban-local-bodies.name: Urban Local Bodies of Chandigarh
st-ch-urban-local-bodies.description: The urban local self-government bodies of Chandigarh (municipal corporations, municipalities/municipal councils and nagar/town panchayats), constituted under Part IXA of the Constitution.
st-ch-urban-local-bodies.legalBasis: Constitution of India, Part IXA (74th Amendment, 1992)
st-ch-urban-local-bodies.notes: Only the municipal-corporation count is directly sourced (Wikipedia 'List of municipal corporations in India', cross-validated against the national total of 273 on lgdirectory.gov.in's dashboard). Municipality/nagar-panchayat (municipal council / nagar panchayat) counts per state were not obtainable without the CAPTCHA-gated LGD per-state reports or an additional secondary source, and are left out rather than estimated.

st-ch-dept-agriculture.name: Agriculture
st-ch-dept-agriculture.description: Runs extension services, input subsidies and crop-support schemes for farmers and oversees agricultural policy and marketing infrastructure.

st-ch-dept-animal-husbandry-and-fisherie.name: Animal Husbandry & Fisheries
st-ch-dept-animal-husbandry-and-fisherie.description: Runs veterinary services, dairy development and livestock health programmes to support animal-owning farmers.

st-ch-dept-art-and-culture.name: Art & Culture
st-ch-dept-art-and-culture.description: Promotes the state's arts, language, heritage and cultural festivals.

st-ch-dept-chandigarh-transport-undertak.name: Chandigarh Transport Undertaking
st-ch-dept-chandigarh-transport-undertak.description: Regulates road transport, runs the state road transport corporation/undertaking and issues driving licences and vehicle registrations.

st-ch-dept-cooperation.name: Cooperation
st-ch-dept-cooperation.description: Registers and regulates cooperative societies, including credit, marketing and sugar-mill cooperatives, and audits their finances.

st-ch-dept-dc-office.name: Deputy Commissioner's Office
st-ch-dept-dc-office.description: Chandigarh's district administration: land revenue, magistracy, licensing and coordination of central schemes, headed by the Deputy Commissioner.

st-ch-dept-education.name: Education
st-ch-dept-education.description: Runs Chandigarh's government schools and administers the UT's school curriculum and teacher recruitment.

st-ch-dept-election.name: Election
st-ch-dept-election.description: Prepares electoral rolls and conducts Lok Sabha and municipal corporation elections in the Union Territory.

st-ch-dept-electrical-inspectorate.name: Electrical Inspectorate
st-ch-dept-electrical-inspectorate.description: Certifies electrical installations and enforces electrical-safety regulations.

st-ch-dept-employment.name: Employment
st-ch-dept-employment.description: Runs employment exchanges that register jobseekers and match them to vacancies.

st-ch-dept-engineering.name: Engineering
st-ch-dept-engineering.description: Designs, builds and maintains government buildings and public infrastructure.

st-ch-dept-environment.name: Environment
st-ch-dept-environment.description: Regulates pollution control and environmental clearances and runs environment-protection programmes.

st-ch-dept-estate-office.name: Estate Office
st-ch-dept-estate-office.description: Allots and manages government residential and commercial estate property.

st-ch-dept-excise-and-taxation.name: Excise & Taxation
st-ch-dept-excise-and-taxation.description: Collects state excise duty, VAT/GST and other indirect taxes, and licenses the liquor trade.

st-ch-dept-finance.name: Finance
st-ch-dept-finance.description: Prepares the state budget, manages treasury and public debt, and controls government expenditure and pay/pension rules.

st-ch-dept-food-and-supplies-and-consume.name: Food & Supplies and Consumer Affairs and Legal Metrology
st-ch-dept-food-and-supplies-and-consume.description: Runs the public distribution system (ration shops), and enforces consumer-protection and weights-and-measures law.

st-ch-dept-forest-and-wildlife.name: Forest & Wildlife
st-ch-dept-forest-and-wildlife.description: Manages state forests and wildlife sanctuaries, enforces forest and wildlife protection law, and runs afforestation programmes.

st-ch-dept-health.name: Health
st-ch-dept-health.description: Runs government hospitals and primary health centres, public-health programmes and disease control for citizens.

st-ch-dept-hospitality.name: Hospitality
st-ch-dept-hospitality.description: Runs official guest houses and manages hospitality for state government functions and VIP visits.

st-ch-dept-industries.name: Industries
st-ch-dept-industries.description: Promotes industrial investment, runs industrial estates and administers incentives for MSMEs and large industry.

st-ch-dept-information-technology.name: Information Technology
st-ch-dept-information-technology.description: Drives e-governance, IT infrastructure and the promotion of the state's IT/ITeS industry.

st-ch-dept-labour.name: Labour
st-ch-dept-labour.description: Enforces labour law, registers factories/establishments, runs the Employees' State Insurance and welfare boards, and resolves industrial disputes.

st-ch-dept-law-and-prosecution.name: Law & Prosecution
st-ch-dept-law-and-prosecution.description: Conducts criminal prosecution on behalf of the state in the courts.

st-ch-dept-local-audit.name: Local Audit
st-ch-dept-local-audit.description: Audits the accounts of local bodies and government-funded institutions in the Union Territory.

st-ch-dept-local-government.name: Local Government
st-ch-dept-local-government.description: Oversees municipal corporations, councils and committees that run civic services in towns and cities.

st-ch-dept-personnel.name: Personnel
st-ch-dept-personnel.description: Handles recruitment rules, service matters, transfers and cadre management of state government employees.

st-ch-dept-police.name: Police
st-ch-dept-police.description: Maintains law and order, investigates crime and provides public safety and traffic policing.

st-ch-dept-printing-and-stationery.name: Printing & Stationery
st-ch-dept-printing-and-stationery.description: Runs government printing presses and supplies stationery and forms to government offices.

st-ch-dept-public-relations.name: Public Relations
st-ch-dept-public-relations.description: Runs the administration's press, publicity and public-information machinery.

st-ch-dept-revenue.name: Revenue
st-ch-dept-revenue.description: Administers land records, land revenue, tenancy law and disaster relief through the district revenue administration.

st-ch-dept-science-and-technology-and-re.name: Science & Technology & Renewable Energy
st-ch-dept-science-and-technology-and-re.description: Funds scientific research, technology promotion and pollution/environment regulation.

st-ch-dept-social-welfare-women-and-chil.name: Social Welfare, Women & Child Development
st-ch-dept-social-welfare-women-and-chil.description: Runs anganwadi/ICDS child-nutrition centres, women's welfare and child-protection schemes.

st-ch-dept-sports.name: Sports
st-ch-dept-sports.description: Builds sports infrastructure and runs coaching, talent-promotion and youth-development schemes.

st-ch-dept-technical-education.name: Technical Education
st-ch-dept-technical-education.description: Runs polytechnics and regulates technical/engineering education in the state.

st-ch-dept-transport.name: Transport
st-ch-dept-transport.description: Regulates road transport, runs the state road transport corporation/undertaking and issues driving licences and vehicle registrations.

st-ch-dept-tourism.name: Tourism
st-ch-dept-tourism.description: Promotes tourist destinations, runs state tourism corporations/hotels and markets the state to visitors.

st-ch-dept-urban-planning.name: Urban Planning
st-ch-dept-urban-planning.description: Prepares statutory master plans and building-control regulations for urban development.

st-ch-dept-vigilance.name: Vigilance
st-ch-dept-vigilance.description: Investigates corruption and misconduct by government officials and enforces integrity in public service.

st-ch-dept-sainik-welfare.name: Sainik Welfare
st-ch-dept-sainik-welfare.description: Runs welfare schemes and pensions for ex-servicemen and their families in the Union Territory.

st-ch-dept-home.name: Home Department
st-ch-dept-home.description: Handles Union Territory home affairs administration for Chandigarh, including police oversight, jails and criminal-justice coordination, working under the Chandigarh Administration and MHA.

st-ch-dept-water-resources.name: Water Resources
st-ch-dept-water-resources.description: Manages water supply infrastructure, groundwater regulation and water-resource planning for the Union Territory of Chandigarh.

st-ch-mc-chandigarh.name: Municipal Corporation of Chandigarh
st-ch-mc-chandigarh.description: The elected civic body of Chandigarh responsible for sanitation, water supply, local roads and other municipal services; 35 elected councillors plus nominated members, headed by a Mayor elected annually from among the councillors.
st-ch-mc-chandigarh.legalBasis: Punjab Municipal Corporation Act, 1976 (as extended to Chandigarh)
st-ch-mc-chandigarh.head: st-ch-pos-mayor

st-ch-electorate.name: People of Chandigarh
st-ch-electorate.description: The residents and voters of Chandigarh, a Union Territory administered by the Union government.

st-ch-pos-secretary-dc-office.title: Deputy Commissioner, Deputy Commissioner's Office, Chandigarh

in-hc-punjab-and-haryana.name: Punjab and Haryana High Court
in-hc-punjab-and-haryana.description: High Court for Punjab, Haryana, Chandigarh, seated at Chandigarh. Sanctioned judge strength 85 (64 permanent + 21 additional); 64 in position, 21 vacant as of the Dept. of Justice statement dated 2026-07-01 (cross-checked against Wikipedia data current to 2026-09-25). Senior-most puisne (non-Chief) judge as of 2026-09-25: Justice Deepak Sibal.
